text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Training for the Yushun Himba (Oaks) has 
begun. Maybe 2,400m is too long for me, 
because it's really, really tough...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
And so... my weight ended up fluctuating. 
After consulting with my Trainer, we 
decided to take a break for a while.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I didn't want to worry you, but I'm really 
glad we talked. And getting to eat 
together, too... You're so kind, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
With things turning out like this for the 
Yushun Himba (Oaks), I'm a little 
anxious... but until race day, I just have 
to do my best.
